new_dimensions.Description: Degree to which the patient’s diagnosis, symptom picture, and case formulation are clear, ambiguous, or evolving.
new_dimensions.Numerical values: regression from 0 to 1 scale (0=ambiguous, 1=fully clear)
new_dimensions.Rationale: Needed to distinguish between cases where information is missing, ambiguous, or where the therapist is actively seeking or revising clarity; guides conversational and clinical strategy.

new_dimensions.Description: Extent to which a structured, sufficient account of the patient’s relevant personal, developmental, and clinical history has been elicited and documented.
new_dimensions.Numerical values: regression from 0 to 1 scale
new_dimensions.Rationale: Distinguishes whether adequate background/contextual information has been gathered for case formulation, beyond fleeting mentions of context/factors.

new_dimensions.Description: Whether (and how recently) standardized assessment tools, rating scales, or questionnaires have been administered and reviewed with the patient.

new_dimensions.Description: Degree to which the patient presents with multiple, overlapping, or comorbid conditions, symptom clusters, or diagnostic ambiguity complicating straightforward formulation.
new_dimensions.Numerical values: regression from 0 to 1 scale
new_dimensions.Rationale: Important for distinguishing cases requiring more extensive assessment/formulation efforts and guiding need for clarity or simplification.

new_dimensions.Description: Primary focus/theme of the current session or segment, distinguishing core belief/schema work, surface restructuring, behavioral work, etc.

new_dimensions.Description: Tracks the working phase within core belief intervention: identification, monitoring, restructuring, strengthening, consolidation/maintenance.
new_dimensions.Numerical values: regression from 0 (not started) to 1 (maintenance/consolidation phase)
new_dimensions.Rationale: Allows agent to track which procedural phase of schema/core belief work the patient is currently engaging in.

new_dimensions.Description: Distinguishes whether a belief is newly identified, longstanding (previously known), or hypothetical/under exploration.
